description:
Use this when you need a deterministic New Zealand national statutory offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a regional anniversary or employer-specific calendar.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts New Zealand national working days in exact 2026-2027 coverage.
Example user requests: Add one New Zealand working day after 2027-02-05.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-05","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, holiday_names, calendar_scope, regional_anniversary_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on New Zealand status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/new-zealand-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/new-zealand-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_new_zealand_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

holiday_names.description: National holidays applying on the date.

regional_anniversary_day_policy.description: Regional anniversary days are not inferred.

sources.description: Official New Zealand Government and Employment New Zealand sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add New Zealand Working Days
